scene: You zoom down the bright halfpipe and catch big neon air.
picture: A flat side view along the neon halfpipe. On the far left rises the orange ramp lip. In the centre, the player leaps in mid-air in her red bomber jacket and white skates, reaching upward. Directly above her hovers a glowing gold trophy. Up high spans a thick sparking cable. On the right, a flat-roofed noodle shack awaits.
shown: a sparking steel cable up high stretching overhead between twin towers
a floating golden trophy in the centre above the ramp curve
a glowing rooftop noodle shack with flat awning on the right

variants.scene: You shoot off the orange curve into the glowing twilight sky.
Midair, the aroma of hot ramen drifts up past your skates.
Spectators cheer as you fly sky-high above the city roofs.
